findings.passage: Free and fair elections are essential to ensuring government reflects the will of the people. I support voter ID, limited early voting, rare absentee by‑mail voting, and secure paper ballots on Election Day. I voted for House Bills 958 and 834 to strengthen election rules, give nonpartisan candidates a greater role in the process, and require audits after each general election so every vote is counted with confidence.
findings.note: Election Integrity section of his campaign home page. The page was last modified 2026-10-08 per its own metadata; the exact date the text was written is not shown. States support for voter ID, limited early voting, rare mail voting, and says he voted for HB 958 and HB 834.

findings.passage: HB 958 — Election Law Changes — Yea to reform early voting, citizenship verification, expand election audits, voter‑roll maintenance, and observer rules.
findings.note: His campaign site's list of bills from his first term describes his Yea vote on HB 958 and names citizenship verification among its subjects. Page last modified 2026-10-08.

findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading (House vote 66-47)
findings.note: Member's vote is listed as Aye on the House second reading. The bill (Committee Substitute 4) lengthens to the fifth business day after an election the deadline for a voter to bring acceptable photo ID to the county board after casting a provisional ballot without it, and the same deadline for curing ID-number mismatches and for absentee-ballot ID or affidavit deficiencies (G.S. 163-166.16(c), 163-166.12(d), 163-230.1(e1)). Bill text is https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H958v5.pdf.
